builds.name: Reference: Tempo and pursuit
builds.goal: Reference for Zilean: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A tempo-control mage who sets double-bomb stuns, repeatedly alters movement speed and prevents one ally death through a timed revive. Measure double-bomb stun, speed/slow cycling and actual revive value. AP/tank spending must preserve enough mana/haste and allied uptime to justify lost utility slots. Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape.
builds.summary: Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape.
testPlan: Kit question for Zilean: Measure double-bomb stun, speed/slow cycling and actual revive value. AP/tank spending must preserve enough mana/haste and allied uptime to justify lost utility slots.

Start with the early core (Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.

The route fails Zilean's stated kit question: Measure double-bomb stun, speed/slow cycling and actual revive value. AP/tank spending must preserve enough mana/haste and allied uptime to justify lost utility slots.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.
Full cost 10,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Imperial Mandate, Redemption, Mikael's Blessing are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After [3] seconds it detonates, dealing [75 / 115 / 165 / 230 / 300 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage.

Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for [1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5] seconds.

Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for [5] seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for [3] seconds, then reviving them and restoring [600 / 850 / 1100 + (2) × AP] Health.
Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by [10] seconds.
Zilean Slows an enemy champion by [40 / 55 / 70 / 85 / 99]% or grants an allied champion [40 / 55 / 70 / 85 / 99]% Move Speed for [2.5] seconds.

builds.name: Rewind attack interlude
builds.summary: Test one Spellblade attack between a first bomb and the rewind-assisted second bomb.
builds.goal: Test one Spellblade attack between a first bomb and the rewind-assisted second bomb.
builds.hypothesis: Q waits three seconds unless a second bomb on the same unit detonates it and stuns. W removes ten seconds from other basic cooldowns; Lich Bane rewards an actual attack between the casts, and Nashor tests continued attacks during the double-bomb stun. E controls the approach while AP powers bombs and R revival healing.
testPlan: Required state: First bomb attached, W ready and the attack cannot delay second Q past detonation.
Compare Q-W-Q with Q-attack-W-Q at the same Q cooldown, tracking stun and item packets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The attack makes the second bomb miss or expire, losing the stun and burst.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W does not reset Spellblade item cooldown or the ultimate.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Seraph's Embrace, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Chronoshift recovery escort
builds.summary: Test movement and ally-heal delivery around an actual triggered revival.
builds.goal: Test movement and ally-heal delivery around an actual triggered revival.
builds.hypothesis: E gives up to 99% movement speed or slow for 2.5 seconds. R marks an ally for five seconds and on lethal damage revives after three seconds stasis with 2 AP healing; Staff/Moonstone can be tested for eligibility on that heal. Shurelya helps the revived ally exit, while Mikael addresses eligible control.
testPlan: Required state: R actually triggers on the intended ally, and allies remain nearby after the three-second stasis.
Record revive heal and Staff/Moonstone activation, then escape distance with timed E/Shurelya.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
